ask: A car blowing up in the street, heard from a few metres away. A sharp crack, a deep boom that drops in pitch, then a second or two of small bits of metal and glass rattling down on tarmac. Big but short and a little cartoonish, not a war film. Mono, no music, no voices.
why: It ends every wrecked car, so it is heard many times an hour and is in most chase clips. The code version is filtered noise and a sine drop (src/vehicles/mayhem-sound.mod.js, recipe 55 in the sound bible).
